info.bio:
Agent Orange es una banda de punk de Fullerton, California. Fueron una banda de Surf-Rock desde la década de 1980 y al principio ganaron atención con su canción Bloodstains la cual escribieron para un álbum compilatorio local.

Agent Orange ha sido una gran influencia en la escena punk, siendo una de las primeras bandas en explorar lo que más tarde sería conocido como Skate-Punk. La banda sigue en activo con pocos cambios en sus miembros.

scenes.name: Hardcore
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: El punk como «violento, rápido y ruidoso» tarda en conquistar EE UU, pero cuando lo hace el hardcore se convierte durante dos décadas en el idioma nacional de millones de chavales. Misfits y el «scum-rock»; el crossover punk-metal (Suicidal Tendencies, Corrosion Of Conformity, Agnostic Front); Mission Of Burma en Boston. Washington: Bad Brains (reggae, funk y metal diez años por delante), Minor Threat (el «straight-edge») y Rites Of Spring, inventores del emo-core. San Francisco: Dead Kennedys de Jello Biafra, D.R.I. (thrash antes que Metallica), Flipper. Los «beach punks» de Los Ángeles: Germs, X, Black Flag (Damaged), Descendents, Gun Club (Fire Of Love), Bad Religion. El jazz-core de Minutemen y Saccharine Trust; en el Medio Oeste, Husker Du y Replacements cambian el hardcore para siempre; en Chicago, Naked Raygun y Big Black de Steve Albini; en Europa, The Ex y los italianos CCCP.

mentions.author: Piero Scaruffi
mentions.text: …the meantime, hardcore had already become more reasonable, thanks to bands that sang melodies instead of just screaming like maniacs, bands such as Agent Orange (1), full of nostalgy for the sound of the Sixties (surf, Merseybeat) despite the quintessentially Eighties despair of Living In Darkness (1981),…

podcast.title: Influence on Major Artists
podcast.body: Agent Orange is cited among several California hardcore bands that were very important to the musical education of figures like Eddie Vedder and Dave Grohl. "Talk to Eddie Vetter or Dave Grohl, and they'll tell you how some of these bands were really, really important to their musical education."

podcast.title: Pioneers of Surf/Punk Integration
podcast.body: Formed in Orange County in 1979, Agent Orange was one of the first bands to not just cover surf songs but to deeply incorporate the surf feel into punk rock, influencing skate punk and snowboarders. "Agent Orange was formed in Orange County. I mean, where else? In 1979, and they were one of the first bands of their type, not to just cover surf songs, which they did, but to really incorporate the surf feel with punk rock."
